class: Running a branch's migration (replay) tests against a database shared with other checkouts applies the branch's unmerged migration and can leave the shared database at a different revision than main - every other checkout's local DB tests then run against a schema they do not have.
mechanism: atool.py --no-tests runs every tests_app file that touches alembic/_migration_replay through db_run.py when the branch changes a migration. W-017 added 0015 with a downgrade that raised; the replay tests (downgrade to base, upgrade head) stopped midway and left the shared ofo_test database at 0013 while main's head was 0014.

first_seen.where: GC-2b item 4, W-017 (branch build/W-017-allowlist), local CI mirror
first_seen.evidence: atool: 'migration tests (14 files) rc 1 | 0015_audit_broker_allowlist.py:86: RuntimeError / 6 failed, 894 passed in 2128.45s'; then `alembic current` on ofo_test -> '0013_exchange_freeze_limits' (main head 0014); restored with `alembic upgrade head` from main -> '0014_charge_rates_caps (head)'

fix: Habit until structural: after any local run of a branch's migration tests, check `alembic current` on the shared test DB and restore main's head. Structural option (open): the mirror runs migration replay tests in a throwaway database (CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE, dropped after) or leaves them to CI only.

detection.note: Found by checking `alembic current` after the failing mirror run.

occurrences.evidence: shared ofo_test left at 0013; restored to 0014
